entries.code_description: Appearing at least four times a week
entries.comment: Printed books, brochures, leaflets and similar printed products, except books, brochures, leaflets and similar printed products, in which advertising and advertising represent, individually or together, more than 50% of the total content of the product. Exhaustive list can be found in Annex 7 of Act No. 222/2004 Coll. on Value Added Tax as amended via the following link https://www.mfsr.sk/en/taxes-customs-accounting/indirect-taxes/vat/
